lines.text: Anthropic opens a waitlisted preview of Claude Duet, an agent app that works on its own cloud computer
OpenAI says AI found critical PHP flaws before attackers did; PHP has shipped fixes, so patch now
LiteLLM's 1.107.0 release carried credential-stealing malware for about two hours; users told to rotate keys

feed.headline: Anthropic opens a waitlisted research preview of Claude Duet, a proactive agent app built around Opus 5.5
feed.why: It runs on its own cloud computer and keeps working when you step away. US Pro and Max only for now, sharing your plan's usage limits.

feed.headline: OpenAI: AI helped find critical PHP flaws before attackers did; PHP has shipped fixes
feed.why: PHP is used to run websites and web apps. OpenAI calls it one of the most impactful security issues in recent memory and expects more such finds.

feed.headline: LiteLLM's 1.107.0 release shipped credential-stealing malware for about two hours before it was pulled
feed.why: LiteLLM holds the API keys for many AI apps. Anyone who installed that version should assume compromise and rotate every key.

feed.headline: Nvidia's DSX POD ships whole AI data centers in factory-built containers, from early 2027
feed.why: Nvidia says it cuts setup at a prepared site from six months to as little as 14 days.

feed.headline: Recursive releases Flint, a free 40B coding model built to run on a laptop
feed.why: Apache 2.0 weights on Hugging Face. The speed and coding scores are Recursive's own; Artificial Analysis hasn't tested it yet.

feed.headline: Dario Amodei defends Anthropic's 'race to the top' and says it could have handled three points better
feed.why: He lists nine safety calls he says cost Anthropic money, including holding its Mythos models back for four months.

feed.headline: Anthropic may publicly file its IPO paperwork as soon as Friday, sources tell Yahoo Finance
feed.why: The S-1 would be the first official look at Anthropic's money. Anthropic hasn't commented on timing.

feed.headline: Mistral Large 4's open weights are due by the end of October
feed.why: Mistral says the 1-trillion-parameter model is in preview now and its weights drop by month's end.
